premises.text: Bike theft volume and insurance losses show security tech is inadequate
premises.evidence_span: not only that, there's more than one bicycle stolen every minute in Europe alone

premises.text: Keyless locks and trackers exist separately but are not integrated
Lock8 integrates alarm, secure build, GPS tracking, and keyless unlock
premises.evidence_span: It has to have an alarm. It has to be secure. And it has to be GPS trackable, because we don't know if it might fail eventually. And above all, it has to have a keyless mechanism

premises.text: Sensors (vibration, gyroscope, temperature, light, hot-wired cable) detect attack modes
premises.evidence_span: A light sensor makes sure that no drill can go through

premises.text: App arms the lock, notifies on tamper, and shows lock location
premises.evidence_span: Not only that but I can locate myself I can locate my lock where my lock is

premises.text: Platform supports bike/lock rental and city expansion without connected infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: we don't need connected infrastructure. We just need simple devices in Lockheed

value.text: Protect bikes and enable trusted sharing/rental
value.evidence_span: you can rent your bike out to whoever you want, and you can rest assured that your bike will be safe

causal_links.evidence_span: bike security tech today is not that advanced
truly disrupt what bicycle sharing is all about

notes: ASR Lockade/LockAid/Lockheed spellings preserved in spans. Kickstarter mention excluded as financing channel.
